title: After passing priority, Keeper of Masks' play trigger resolved and created two tokens in base, but they appear (in both the snapshot/trace and the AFTER screenshot) as plain 'Reflection' units with 0 Might and definitionId token-def-reflection — not as copies of Keeper of Masks (name Keeper of Masks, 1 Might, cost 2, Hidden, Temporary).
expected: Trace step 35 shows both tokens as {def:'token-def-reflection', name:'Reflection', might:0}. Engine create-token.ts:121-150 registers each token *instance id* in the global registry as a copy of the source (Keeper of Masks payload, which is registered per-instance via pregame.ts:74/makeLookupPayload), but the shared definitionId 'token-def-reflection' is registered at create-token.ts:101-109 with the literal 0-Might Reflection stats. server/snapshot.ts:366-368 resolves `def` only via `registry.get(cardInstance.definitionId) ?? getGlobalCardRegistry().get(cardInstance.definitionId)` — never by instance id — so lines 397-398 emit might 0 / name 'Reflection' instead of the copy's Keeper of Masks traits.
